verdict.rationale: Grafana documents its own background automation: alert rules that it 'will continuously evaluate and send notifications', automatic escalation to on-call people, recording rules, and Knowledge Graph insights that are 'continuously generated'. These are fixed-purpose observability automations, not general user-defined or AI-agent automations, so the agentic side of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-configurable automation or workflow triggers, autonomous AI-agent background tasks (Assistant/Investigations running unattended), and documentation of scheduling or actions beyond notifications.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Grafana will continuously evaluate and send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie.
escalate alerts to the people who are on call
create new data through the use of recording rules, and set up alerting rules across multiple tenants
It continuously generates insights that highlight saturation, errors, anomalies, failures, and configuration changes
